source_caption_text:
This might be one of Cole’s smoothest flows ever 😮‍💨🔥

J. Cole’s closing verse on “Sacrifices” is one of the most memorable moments from Dreamville’s 2019 compilation album Revenge of the Dreamers III. After standout performances from Smino, Saba, and EARTHGANG, Cole closes the nearly six-minute track with a verse that combines technical precision with genuine emotion.

Cole begins with a calm, conversational flow before gradually increasing his pace and intensity. His delivery becomes faster and more intricate as he reflects on his journey, his struggles, and the gratitude he feels toward his family, creating a natural progression that keeps building throughout the verse.

What makes the performance especially powerful is how closely Cole’s delivery matches the emotion behind his words. His voice becomes increasingly vulnerable as he reflects on his wife and growing family, turning the closing verse into a deeply personal moment that still resonates with fans years later.

#jcole #hiphop #rap
